name: Denah Rumah Dunia
tagline: bumi kosong, kalian yang menentukan isinya

tts.style:
# AUDIO PROFILE: Dena, a bright young female architect (early twenties), the narrator of a premium animated series.
## SCENE: telling her own funny, slightly chaotic space-colony story to the audience, right after crash-landing on an empty alien planet.
### DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Style: smart, chatty and cheerful; fast and full of energy; a perfectionist who gets playfully panicky when measurements are off; lively pitch variation; amused at punchlines.
Pacing: quick and bubbly but every word clear; short comic pause before punchlines (marked ...).
Accent: natural casual Jakarta Indonesian, like a young Indonesian content creator; never sounds foreign.
